status: Shared scope storage and completed-node memoization are integrated into normal production TypeScript. Historical prototype evidence is retained. Dependency manifests and installed packages are unchanged.
bottleneck: Language-service scope construction and repeated identifier normalization dominate validation. Parsing is a small fraction of the completed workloads.

methodology.sources: The same seven largest production .pq connectors used by the parser investigation; source SHA-256 verified.
methodology.dependencyWiring: Node synchronous module hooks redirect all root/deep parser imports to local 8d4976f, including formatter imports. No npm link or dependency edits.
methodology.library: 866 definitions from this repository's standard-library fixture; no host-specific/SDK external resolver. Diagnostics and costs depend on this configuration.
methodology.repeats: One warmup and three arithmetic-mean samples, candidate before baseline in separate processes; earlier pilots used the opposite order. This is not a statistical confidence interval.
methodology.gc: Explicit full GC before each document iteration, outside phase timers. Natural GC inside each phase is included.
methodology.phases: Validation functions follow the public validate pipeline on a successful parse, sharing its scope/type cache. Editor operations use a separate analysis; parse is awaited before timing them. Autocomplete uses the median value-identifier position; hover follows it and is warm.
methodology.limits: 4 GiB V8 old-space limit; validation stages have a 20-second cooperative cancellation token except the initial OOM pilot (120 seconds). Failures are never included as successful timing samples.
methodology.memory: heapUsed at phase end is not peak or retained heap. Physical map-entry counts count shared native Map instances once, plus separately reported hidden-key sets; they are not byte estimates.

productionPort.implementation: Per-owner ScopeBindings precomputes allowed aliases and shares immutable binding descriptors. BindingScopeMap masks nonrecursive self aliases; merged read-only maps share parent frames. Duplicate aliases retain materialized-map fallback. A WeakMap per scope cache tracks fully inspected AST/context objects with a WeakSet, invalidated when cache size shrinks.
productionPort.differencesFromPrototype: Per-owner precomputation replaces global interning caches. Completion uses AST/context identity instead of numeric node IDs. Parent-chain lookup and enumeration are iterative; merged enumeration materializes only on demand.
productionPort.methodology: Normal compiled implementation with SCOPE_EXPERIMENT unset, one warmup and three measured samples per connector. Compared with recorded pre-port baseline; not a contemporaneous paired comparison or statistical confidence interval. Compiled hashes identify the uncommitted implementation independently of git HEAD.
productionPort.compatibility: ReadonlyMap lookup, iteration order, recursive aliases and outer shadowing are preserved. Native Map identity is not guaranteed. Scope caches are document/settings-scoped and must be cleared before reuse; backing maps are immutable after publication.
productionPort.verification: All 150 cases / 3,858 scopes match the original baseline with both parsers. Diagnostics and editor outputs match baseline on every production confirmation iteration for the two successful connectors.

checks.localParser: The source Mocha suite with a parser-only module preload: 743 passing.
checks.initialCompiledSuiteAttempt: 737 passing, six failures because tsc does not copy .pq resource fixtures into lib/test/files. Re-ran the source suite with the same local-parser hook so original resource paths resolve; all 743 passed. No product changes were needed.

productionPort.limitations: This port does not resolve the separately recorded inference/cancellation invariants. No successful full-corpus validation or largest-input end-to-end speedup is claimed.

profiles.invocationBeforeObservation: Cancelled after about 20.6 seconds. regexMatchLength accounts for 44.6% of self-samples, GC 7.7%; key/value iteration and scope-item construction also prominent. Cancellation handling itself contributes samples near the end.
profiles.unknownAfterObservation: After the combined prototype, calculateJaroWinklers is 68.1% and case normalization 9.2% of unknown-identifier self-samples.

experiments.structure: WeakMap caches for allowed identifier spellings and immutable recursive/nonrecursive binding descriptors, keyed by AST identity.
experiments.result: Capacity pilot: invocation 10.66s versus 10.84s baseline, no convincing isolated CPU improvement. Phase-end heap 239 MiB versus 852 MiB; useful allocation reduction, not a retained-heap or peak-memory measurement.

experiments.structure: Interning plus a WeakMap<scope-cache, Set<node-id>> of fully inspected nodes. Distinguishes an assigned scope from a node whose children have already been processed.
experiments.result: Capacity pilot: invocation 1.94s, unknown identifiers 2.41s, autocomplete 0.67s. Avoids re-enumerating ancestor sections/let bindings for each identifier.

experiments.structure: Memo prototype plus one shared sibling-binding table per scope owner, tiny self-binding masks/recursive overrides, and parent-linked ReadonlyMap views. Duplicate-alias groups fall back to materialized entries to preserve native Map iteration order.
experiments.result: Confirmed on CapacityMetricsCES and BQECore; see comparison. Capacity stores 12,497 physical map entries instead of 3,388,313, with 2,506 additional hidden-key set entries.
experiments.limitation: Historical prototype only; the productionPort section records the integrated implementation separately. Native Map identity changes and document-scoped cache assumptions still apply.

failures.outcome: Invocation validation exhausted the 4 GiB heap after about 73 seconds of process runtime; no complete timing sample.
Invocation validation exceeded the 20-second deadline; cancellation surfaced as an invariant wrapping a Result object.

largeInputPrototypeCaveat: Memo still times out on Siteimprove. Overlay reaches invocation-inference invariants on Siteimprove and CCHTagetik instead of the earlier resource limit. These are NOT successful validations or proven end-to-end speedups; their equivalence to an unlimited baseline remains unresolved.

verification.scopeResults: All intern/memo/overlay scope values, key iteration order and errors match baseline across both built-in parsers, shadowing, recursion, quoted/generalized identifiers, duplicate aliases and incomplete prefixes.
verification.existingScopeTests: 76 existing compiled scope/scope-type tests pass with overlay and the local parser.
verification.realInputs: Diagnostic and editor-output hashes match on all recorded confirmation samples for the two successful connectors.

recommendations: Review the integrated shared scope maps and completed-node index, especially ReadonlyMap compatibility and document-scoped cache lifetime.
